gloss: required items; prescribed items (on a form)

definitions.gloss: required items; prescribed items (on a form)
definitions.explanation: The items that must be filled in or recorded as specified by rules, regulations, or a form's instructions. A bureaucratic term used on application forms, contracts, and official notices to indicate fields the user is required to complete.

examples.japanese: {所定事項|しょていじこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please fill in the required items.

examples.japanese: {所定事項|しょていじこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{漏|も}れ→漏れ：13362_more⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: Check that there are no omissions in the required items.

examples.japanese: ⟦{申込書|もうしこみしょ}→申込書：03162_moushikomisho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{所定事項|しょていじこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すべて⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧、⟦{郵送|ゆうそう}→郵送：03176_yuusou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please fill in all the required items on the application form and mail it.

examples.japanese: {所定事項|しょていじこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}{漏|も}れ→記入漏れ：20461_kinyuumore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ございます→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧。
examples.english: If there are any omissions in the required items, we may not be able to accept the application.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{所定|しょてい}→所定：12938_shotei⟧ (predetermined; as specified) and ⟦{事項|じこう}→事項：11469_jikou⟧ (matter; item). Literally "the prescribed items," referring to the fields or information that a form or regulation designates as mandatory.

USAGE:
A formal, bureaucratic word that appears almost exclusively in written instructions on forms, contracts, and official notices. You will see it on application forms, customs declarations, and legal documents. Not used in casual conversation — in spoken Japanese, people say {必要事項|ひつようじこう} or just explain "the required fields."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {所定事項|しょていじこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fill in the required items
- {所定事項|しょていじこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}{漏|も}れ→記入漏れ：20461_kinyuumore⟧: omission of required items
- {所定事項|しょていじこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{明記|めいき}→明記：13030_meiki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to clearly state the required items

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {必要事項|ひつようじこう}: necessary items — nearly synonymous and more common in everyday forms
- {記載事項|きさいじこう}: items to be written; items entered — emphasizes what is (or must be) written down, often used on certificates
- ⟦{所定|しょてい}→所定：12938_shotei⟧⟦{用紙|ようし}→用紙：09588_youshi⟧: prescribed form — the form itself, not the items on it
